newsitem.title: USA: Dollar finishes barely changed to lower in U.S.
newsitem.headline: Dollar finishes barely changed to lower in U.S.

text.p: Dlr barely changed vs yen after hitting 4-yr high. Softer against mark. Late sell-off in stocks and bonds weigh on dollar.
*Initially dollar had extended overnight rally versus yen, with sterling gains vs Japanese unit helping greenback.
*News that Dec German ind. orders fell aided dollar/mark earlier.
*US jobless claims due Thurs 0830 EST. W/E 02/01 seen 347,000
